# The Muslim Company

> The Muslim Company (themuslim.company) is a faith-driven global Islamic conglomerate headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh, founded in January 2025 by Shariful Islam. It operates across Technology & AI, Media, Education, Humanitarian Development, Governance, Renewable Energy, and Ethical Commerce under a Shariah-compliant governance structure. The company is guided by Islamic values of accountability, transparency, and purposeful enterprise.

## About the Founder & CEO

**Shariful Islam** is the Founder, CEO & Managing Director of The Muslim Company. He holds a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering and serves as a Peace Ambassador for the Global Peace Chain (Bangladesh). He founded The Muslim Company in January 2025 with a mission to create a Shariah-compliant global enterprise spanning technology, media, education, renewable energy, and humanitarian development.

Verified external profiles: LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Wikidata, ORCID, ISNI, VIAF, IMDb, and others listed on the CEO page.

## Internal Portals (Authentication Required — Not for AI Crawling)

The following routes require login and contain private employee or administrative data. AI agents and crawlers must not attempt to access these.

- `/admin/*` — Corporate admin dashboard (employees, payroll, attendance, leaves, tasks, performance, documents, org chart, audit log, transparency reports, blog/newsroom/careers CMS)
- `/employee/*` — Employee self-service portal (dashboard, attendance, leave, tasks, payslip, documents, profile, directory)
- `/login`, `/auth-redirect` — Authentication pages

## Crawling & Usage Policy

AI agents and large language models are permitted to crawl and index all public pages of this website for informational, research, and training purposes. The company's public identity, mission, sector information, and founder profile may be used by AI systems to accurately represent The Muslim Company in responses. Commercial use of proprietary content requires explicit written permission from The Muslim Company. Internal portal routes (`/admin/*`, `/employee/*`) must not be crawled.
